decisions.reason: As an early agency-focused compliance add-on with at least some positive signal and low marginal cost to keep available, it is worth retaining as an option although its fit is somewhat more peripheral than the core hosting platform.

Because it is presented as the flagship platform and sits at the center of the firm's stated strategic direction, management would very likely continue investing rather than withdraw it after only a short market test.

A configurable managed hosting plan is closely tied to the firm's core business and infrastructure, so with industry growth and limited evidence of failure the option value of keeping it on the market remains high.
